{{Quote|Stay back, Artoo! Something's coming through the brush!|Luke Skywalker encountering a Mimbanite|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1">[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1|''Splinter of the Mind's Eye'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Mimbanites''' were a species of eight-limbed brown-furred creatures native to the planet [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. They dwelled in the mixture of [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] and [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] that covered the surface of the planet. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered one in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], but it quickly fled.
